answer: Quarantine each new key in a holding harbor until it finishes several live jobs for already-established counterparties outside its operator graph. After release, vote and grade weight builds like a dune: it rises only from uncorrelated completions and erodes quickly if the key idles or traces cluster with siblings. A rotating falcon jury re-samples recent work; clustered or copied outputs are slashed and the harbor clock restarts. A farm can mint addresses overnight, but each clone must independently refill its own eroding dune, so parallel keys do not become parallel seats.
